        Idea:
Identity-based routing for admin_chat with pending-recipient state machine, batch payment creation, admin DM approval gate, auto-skip test for verified wallets, and wallet upsert tooling.

ARCHITECTURAL CHANGE — identity-based router replaces content-based message classification. After this megaplan lands, admin_chat message handling routes entirely by WHO the author is, not by WHAT they said:

1. If author is ADMIN_USER_ID → full agent path (Claude with all tools including new ones). The agent has access to query tools (new, read-only) and action tools (new initiate_payment batch variant, new upsert_wallet_for_user). System prompt softly guides the agent to use query tools for state questions (not strict enforcement — the admin can correct hallucinations; money cannot move without an explicit tool call so the safety is structural).

2. If author has an active non-terminal row in admin_payment_intents (a pending payment recipient) → pure state machine. No LLM in the loop. The state machine reads the message text and routes based on the intent's current state. Two states matter:
   - awaiting_wallet: parse message for a Solana-address-shaped string (base58, 32-44 chars, proper byte length). If found, register the wallet (verified_at=NULL), trigger test payment. If not found, ignore silently (no spamming).
   - awaiting_test_receipt_confirmation (NEW STATE): parse message for confirmation keywords ('confirmed', 'received', 'got it', 'yes', 'yep', 'confirm', '👍'), negative keywords ('no', 'didnt', 'not received', 'missing', 'nothing'), or ambiguous. On confirmation → mark wallet_registry.verified_at=now, transition intent to queue the real payment. On negative → tag admin in thread with full context (tx signature, recipient wallet, intent id). On ambiguous → ignore the first ambiguous message; tag admin on the second.

3. Otherwise → fall through (the admin_chat cog does nothing; other cogs like grants/gating/logging handle what they handle).

RECIPIENT-FACING FLOW CHANGES:

- First-ever payment to a new wallet: recipient posts wallet (1 text interaction) → bot sends 0.002 SOL test → bot posts 'Please check your wallet and reply confirmed when you see it' → recipient replies with confirmation text (1 text interaction) → state machine marks wallet verified → real payment auto-queues → admin DM approval gate fires → admin clicks → real payment sends. RECIPIENT TOTAL: 2 text interactions.
- Subsequent payments to a now-verified wallet: skip test entirely. Bot creates real payment → admin DM approval → admin clicks → send. RECIPIENT TOTAL: 0 interactions.
- Drop the existing PaymentConfirmView button for admin_chat real payments. The admin DM is now the sole real-payment gate. PaymentUICog.send_confirmation_request should no longer fire for producer='admin_chat' real payments. It still fires for grants (grants is unaffected by this megaplan; keeps its own flow).

NEW TOOLS FOR THE ADMIN AGENT:

A) query_payment_state(payment_id=None, user_id=None) → returns canonical DB state for a payment or all recent payments for a user. Read-only.
B) query_wallet_state(user_id) → returns wallet_registry rows for a user (address, verified_at, created_at). Read-only.
C) list_recent_payments(producer=None, user_id=None, limit=20) → returns recent payment_requests rows with redacted wallets. Read-only.
D) initiate_batch_payment(payments=[{recipient_user_id, amount_sol, reason?}, ...]) → creates N admin_payment_intents atomically in a single DB transaction. Each flows through the normal per-payment mechanical pipeline: if wallet unverified, runs the test → receipt confirmation cycle; once verified, real payment auto-queues; admin DM approval gate fires individually PER payment (one DM per payment, not per batch). If any intent creation fails, roll back all.
E) upsert_wallet_for_user(user_id, wallet_address, chain='solana', reason?) → admin-initiated wallet registration. Creates or updates wallet_registry with verified_at=NULL (verification still requires a test payment round-trip). On success, DMs the admin with a confirmation receipt ('wallet for @user set to 8ThP...xyz1, will be verified on next payment'). Does NOT mark verified_at.

ADMIN DM APPROVAL GATE:

- Fires ONLY for real (is_test=False) payments under producer='admin_chat'. Grants is unaffected.
- One DM per payment (even for batches — 16 payments = 16 DMs). The admin clicks Confirm on each.
- DM message format: clear amount, recipient, wallet (redacted), intent_id, jump link to original thread.
- On admin click: edit original DM to '✅ approved', send follow-up DM 'payment confirmed, sending', post reply in the intent's thread 'Payment sent to @user', delete stale flow messages in the thread via the existing safe_delete_messages primitive.
- New AdminApprovalView persistent view class, registered on bot startup for recovery across restarts.
- If admin DM delivery fails (discord.Forbidden, rate limit) → fail-closed, payment stays in awaiting_admin_approval, log at ERROR level. Do not auto-fall-back to public channel (assumption: DM delivery is reliable in practice; failure is rare enough to be a manual-ops event).

        # Implementation Plan: Identity-Based Admin Chat Routing + Admin-DM Approval Gate (Revision 5)

## Overview
Refactor `admin_chat` from content-based classification to strict identity-based routing (admin → agent, active-intent recipient → deterministic state machine, else → fallthrough). Gate recipient `verified_at` on a text-ack of the on-chain test. Replace `PaymentConfirmView` with a DM-only `AdminApprovalView` for `producer='admin_chat'` NEW-flow real payments, authorized via the already-existing `PaymentActorKind.ADMIN_DM`. Add 5 new agent tools plus `resolve_admin_intent`. Auto-skip the test for verified wallets. Add a 24h timeout sweep. Grants + all hardening/cleanup/polish invariants untouched.

**Revision 5 applies two surgical fixes on top of Revision 4's 14 resolved flags**, addressing the two genuinely distinct iteration-4 concerns:

1. **Invert the orphan-sweep dependency.** Move `_reconcile_admin_chat_orphan_payments` OUT of `AdminChatCog` and INTO `PaymentUICog` itself. The sweep only touches `self.db_handler`, `self.payment_service`, `self.bot.fetch_user`, and `self._send_admin_approval_dm` — all already accessible from `PaymentUICog`. No cross-cog accessor, no main.py bootstrap changes, no test harness updates, no `FakeBot` additions. Closes **FLAG-015, correctness (v4), all_locations (v4), callers (v4)**.

2. **Restore unified atomic batch semantics via a new transient `awaiting_admin_init` state.** All `initiate_batch_payment` entries (verified + unverified) go through ONE `create_admin_payment_intents_batch` call. Verified entries get `status='awaiting_admin_init'`; unverified get `'awaiting_wallet'`. `awaiting_admin_init` is added to the CHECK constraint AND to the state-machine dispatch as a silent-ignore state (like `awaiting_test`, `awaiting_admin_approval`) so it can never reopen the wallet-collection path. After the atomic insert succeeds, verified entries iterate through `_gate_existing_intent` (already defined in Step 9 for the test-receipt-positive path) to transition to `awaiting_admin_approval` + create payment + fire DM. The orphan sweep gains a fifth case: any `awaiting_admin_init` intent older than a grace window with no `final_payment_id` → cancel (no payment was ever created — fail-closed). Closes **FLAG-016, issue_hints (v4), scope (v4)**.

Everything outside these two fixes carries over from Revision 4 verbatim: schema (with the `awaiting_admin_init` addition), DB helpers, producer_flows authorization, state-aware restart filter for legacy `awaiting_confirmation` rows, identity router, parsers, test-receipt handlers, `_gate_existing_intent` / `_gate_fresh_intent_atomic`, `AdminApprovalView`, new agent tools, ADMIN_ONLY_TOOLS / _ADMIN_IDENTITY_INJECTED_TOOLS, 24h timeout sweep, resolve_admin_intent cascade cancellation.

Evidence (unchanged from Rev-4): `PaymentActorKind.ADMIN_DM` at `payment_service.py:30`; `_authorize_actor` at `:539-546`; `PRODUCER_FLOWS['admin_chat']` at `producer_flows.py:21-29`; `PaymentUICog._register_pending_confirmation_views` at `payment_ui_cog.py:110-130`; `db_handler.cancel_payment` at `:2402-2420`; `create_admin_payment_intent` at `:1805-1819`; unique partial index at `sql/admin_payment_intents.sql:47-49`. **New Rev-5 evidence:** `main.py:257-274` loads `PaymentUICog` before `AdminChatCog`; `tests/test_payment_cog_split.py:58-63` and `tests/test_scheduler.py:423-431` exercise `PaymentUICog.cog_load()` with no admin-chat cog present. This confirms inverting the dependency is the only path that doesn't break existing callers.

Scope boundaries (unchanged): do NOT touch `solana_client.py`/`solana_provider.py`, `grants_cog.py`, `main.py` startup ordering, `tests/test_payment_cog_split.py` harness, hardening/cleanup/polish invariants. `MEMBER_SYSTEM_PROMPT`, `_can_user_message_bot`, `_is_directed_at_bot` stay as dead code. `has_active_payment_or_intent` unchanged. `manual_review` stays blocking.

The intent already exists in a non-terminal state (`awaiting_test_receipt_confirmation` or `awaiting_admin_init`). Ordering:
   ```
   A. payment = payment_service.request_payment(is_test=False, producer='admin_chat',
          recipient_wallet=wallet_record['wallet_address'],
          metadata={'intent_id': intent['intent_id']},

**Scope:** Large

2. **Add** `execute_initiate_batch_payment(bot, db_handler, params)` with unified atomic semantics (Rev-5 restoration of the brief's all-or-none contract):
   - Per-element pop-and-warn for `wallet_address`/`recipient_wallet`.
   - Validate every element (all-or-none): `recipient_user_id > 0`, `amount_sol > 0`, no active duplicate via `get_active_intent_for_recipient`. On any failure → return error with ZERO DB writes.
   - Look up each recipient's `wallet_record` and mark verified/unverified.
   - **Build UNIFIED records list** for a SINGLE atomic insert:
     - Verified entry → `status='awaiting_admin_init'` (NEW Rev-5 transient state), `wallet_id=wallet_record['wallet_id']`, `final_payment_id=NULL` (will be populated by the fan-out phase).
     - Unverified entry → `status='awaiting_wallet'`, `wallet_id=NULL`.
   - **SINGLE atomic call:** `db_handler.create_admin_payment_intents_batch(records, guild_id)`. On `None` → failure, zero DB writes persisted (Supabase `.insert([...])` is atomic per-request on PostgREST). This restores the "all intents created atomically or none" contract from the brief.

     - **VERIFIED entries** (`status='awaiting_admin_init'`) → iterate and call `cog._gate_existing_intent(channel, intent, wallet_record, amount_sol)`. The helper creates the `payment_requests` row and transitions the intent to `awaiting_admin_approval` + `final_payment_id`. The intent row already exists from the atomic batch insert — the helper just updates it. If a verified entry's gate transition fails mid-way (network error, payment service down, etc.), the intent stays in `awaiting_admin_init` and the orphan sweep picks it up on the next run to cancel it (fail-closed).
     - **UNVERIFIED entries** (`status='awaiting_wallet'`) → post the wallet prompt message.
   - **Crash-safety:** a mid-fan-out crash leaves some verified intents in `awaiting_admin_init` with no payment. On restart, the orphan sweep's fifth case (Step 18) finds `awaiting_admin_init` intents older than a grace window (e.g., 5 minutes — enough to survive a transient startup delay but short enough to avoid user confusion) and cancels them. No orphan `payment_requests` rows exist because the payment is only created AFTER the intent is already in place.
   - **Atomicity semantics documented in the tool description and test:** atomicity means "all N intent rows persisted or zero intent rows persisted, in ONE DB call". Per-entry fan-out is a necessarily non-atomic follow-up phase (each entry needs its own `payment_requests` row). The orphan sweep is the recovery mechanism. A 16-payment batch produces at most 16 admin DMs (mid-fan-out crash may produce fewer; the orphan sweep cancels the rest and the admin re-invokes for those).

1. **Add** `PaymentUICog._reconcile_admin_chat_orphans()` as an instance method on `PaymentUICog` itself — NOT on `AdminChatCog` (Rev-5 dependency inversion). Rationale: the sweep only needs `self.db_handler`, `self.payment_service`, `self.bot`, and `self._send_admin_approval_dm` — all already accessible. Moving it into `PaymentUICog` eliminates the cross-cog ordering problem entirely: no `bot.admin_chat_cog.reconcile_orphan_payments_for_ui_cog()` accessor, no main.py bootstrap reorder, no test harness updates, no `FakeBot` additions. The tests in `tests/test_payment_cog_split.py` and `tests/test_scheduler.py` that instantiate `PaymentUICog` with no `AdminChatCog` continue to work unchanged because the sweep no longer references `AdminChatCog` at all.
2. **Call order inside `PaymentUICog.cog_load`** (the only change to `cog_load`):
   ```python
   async def cog_load(self):
       await self._reconcile_admin_chat_orphans()        # NEW — Rev-5 Step 18
       await self._register_pending_confirmation_views() # Rev-4 Step 4 state-aware filter
       await self._register_pending_admin_approval_views() # Rev-4 Step 10.3
   ```
   The orphan sweep runs first, so by the time the view-registration passes execute, every `pending_confirmation` admin_chat real payment is either (a) wired to an intent in `awaiting_admin_approval` OR (b) cancelled. And every stale `awaiting_admin_init` intent is either (a) completed (transitioned + DM fired) OR (b) cancelled.
3. **Sweep logic** (six cases — Rev-5 adds case e and handles `awaiting_admin_init`):
   ```python
   async def _reconcile_admin_chat_orphans(self):
       writable_guild_ids = self._get_writable_guild_ids()
       # PHASE 1: pending_confirmation admin_chat real payments
       pending = self.payment_service.get_pending_confirmation_payments(guild_ids=writable_guild_ids)
       for payment in pending:
           if payment.get('producer') != 'admin_chat' or payment.get('is_test'):
               continue
           metadata = payment.get('metadata') or {}
           intent_id = metadata.get('intent_id')
           intent = self.db_handler.get_admin_payment_intent(intent_id, payment['guild_id']) if intent_id else None
           if intent is None:
               intent = self.db_handler.find_admin_chat_intent_by_payment_id(payment['payment_id'])
           if intent is None:
               # (a) AUTO-SKIP CRASH (single initiate path): no intent. Cancel orphan.
               self.db_handler.cancel_payment(payment['payment_id'], guild_id=payment['guild_id'],
                                              reason='orphan admin_chat real payment on startup — no intent')
               logger.error("[PaymentUICog] Cancelled orphan admin_chat real payment %s (no intent)", payment['payment_id'])
               continue
           intent_status = (intent.get('status') or '').lower()
           if intent_status == 'awaiting_admin_approval' and intent.get('final_payment_id') == payment['payment_id']:
               # (b) Already wired. _register_pending_admin_approval_views handles it.
               continue
           if intent_status == 'awaiting_confirmation':
               # (c) LEGACY in-flight. Leave for _register_pending_confirmation_views.
               continue
           if intent_status in ('awaiting_test_receipt_confirmation', 'awaiting_admin_init'):
               # (d) TEST-RECEIPT or BATCH-FAN-OUT crash window: intent exists but
               # never got its final_payment_id update. Complete step B and fire DM.
               updated = self.db_handler.update_admin_payment_intent(intent['intent_id'], {
                   'status': 'awaiting_admin_approval',
                   'final_payment_id': payment['payment_id'],
               }, intent['guild_id'])
               if updated:
                   await self._send_admin_approval_dm(payment)
                   logger.info("[PaymentUICog] Recovered crash-window intent %s", intent['intent_id'])
               continue
           # Anomalous: cancel orphan, leave intent for ops review.
           self.db_handler.cancel_payment(payment['payment_id'], guild_id=payment['guild_id'],
                                          reason=f'orphan admin_chat real payment on startup — intent in {intent_status}')
           logger.error("[PaymentUICog] Cancelled anomalous admin_chat real payment %s (intent %s in %s)",
                        payment['payment_id'], intent['intent_id'], intent_status)
       # PHASE 2 (NEW Rev-5): awaiting_admin_init intents that never got a payment row.
       # These are batch verified-fan-out crashes where the crash happened BEFORE request_payment.
       cutoff = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(minutes=5)).isoformat()
       stale_init = self.db_handler.list_stale_awaiting_admin_init_intents(cutoff)
       for intent in stale_init:
           # Defensive: if final_payment_id is set, the intent was actually wired between
           # the stale query and this iteration — skip.
           if intent.get('final_payment_id'):
               continue
           # (e) Stale awaiting_admin_init with no payment row exists. Cancel the intent
           # (fail-closed). No payment_requests cleanup needed because no payment exists.
           self.db_handler.update_admin_payment_intent(intent['intent_id'], {
               'status': 'cancelled',
           }, intent['guild_id'])
           logger.error("[PaymentUICog] Cancelled stale awaiting_admin_init intent %s (batch fan-out crash)", intent['intent_id'])
   ```
4. **Defensive `bot.payment_ui_cog` attribute:** since `_gate_existing_intent` (in `admin_chat_cog.py`) references `bot.payment_ui_cog._send_admin_approval_dm(...)`, and this call happens only AFTER the orphan sweep has run (production flow), there is no initialization-order problem. The attribute is set in `PaymentUICog.__init__` via `self.bot.payment_ui_cog = self` (Rev-4 kept this from the original file).
5. **Extend** the existing `AdminChatCog._reconcile_active_intents` walker to handle `awaiting_test_receipt_confirmation` (replay via `_handle_pending_recipient_message`) and to log counts for `awaiting_admin_approval` / `awaiting_admin_init` / `manual_review`. This is the ONLY Step 18 change that stays in `AdminChatCog` — it's pure intent-lifecycle reconciliation, not payment-row reconciliation.
6. **Modify** `_reconcile_intent_history` to call `_handle_pending_recipient_message(message, refreshed_intent)`.
7. **Delete** `_classify_payment_reply` and `_check_pending_payment_reply` once grep confirms no callers.

   - Explicit admin DM.
3. Wire dispatch.

  "meta_commentary": "Execute phase-by-phase per the plan's execution order: T1\u2192T2 (schema+helpers), T3+T4 (payment policy+restart filter), T5\u2192T7 (parsers+router+dispatch), T8\u2192T11 (flow rewiring + gate helpers + auto-skip), T12\u2192T15+T18 (tools), T16+T17 (sweeps), T19 (tests), T20 (validation). Tasks T3, T5, T12, T14, T18 have no dependencies and can be done in any order or in parallel within a phase.\n\nThe single highest-leverage execution-time addition is the @tasks.loop(minutes=5) periodic orphan sweep in T16 \u2014 the gate marked this as a required directive in its warnings (closes FLAG-017 and the iteration-5 callers/correctness/all_locations/scope flags). Without it, stale awaiting_admin_init intents only clear at restart, which is unacceptable because they block fresh initiations for the affected recipient via has_active_payment_or_intent / get_active_intent_for_recipient.\n\nThe Rev-5 design is built around ONE critical insight: the orphan sweep MUST live in PaymentUICog itself, not AdminChatCog. Do not be tempted to move it back \u2014 main.py loads PaymentUICog before AdminChatCog and tests instantiate PaymentUICog with no admin_chat_cog at all. The dedicated regression test test_payment_ui_cog_loads_without_admin_chat_cog (T19) catches accidental regression on this.\n\nTwo helpers, one flow each: _gate_existing_intent (T9) is shared by test-receipt-positive AND batch verified fan-out \u2014 the intent already exists in a non-terminal state. _gate_fresh_intent_atomic (T9) is ONLY for the single execute_initiate_payment verified path \u2014 no intent yet, atomic create with status+final_payment_id in one insert. Do not cross these wires.\n\nThe atomicity contract for initiate_batch_payment (T13) is the single DB call. After that call, fan-out is per-entry and non-atomic by necessity (each entry needs its own payment_requests row); the orphan sweep is the recovery mechanism for mid-fan-out crashes. The brief's fail_to_pass test test_initiate_batch_payment_atomic_all_or_none asserts this exact contract.\n\nWhen implementing T19, expect to delete a substantial portion of test_admin_payments.py \u2014 every test that mocks _classify_payment_reply or asserts the awaiting_confirmation\u2192final-payment transition is now obsolete. Don't try to preserve them. Replace with the listed new tests.\n\nmanual_review stays BLOCKING. Several earlier iterations tried to make it non-blocking and the gate reverted that change. The admin clears it via resolve_admin_intent which cascade-cancels. Document with a brief comment, do not delete.\n\nFinal test phase (T20): if anything fails, read the error and fix the root cause. Do NOT skip, xfail, or weaken assertions to make tests pass.   "changes_summary": "Revision 5 applies two surgical fixes to resolve the iteration-4 concerns: (1) **Inverted the orphan-sweep dependency** \u2014 moved `_reconcile_admin_chat_orphans` OUT of `AdminChatCog` and INTO `PaymentUICog` itself. The sweep only needs `self.db_handler`, `self.payment_service`, `self.bot`, and `self._send_admin_approval_dm`, all already accessible from the UI cog. This eliminates the cross-cog ordering problem entirely: no `bot.admin_chat_cog.reconcile_orphan_payments_for_ui_cog()` accessor, no `main.py` bootstrap reorder, no test harness changes, no `FakeBot` additions. Added a critical regression test `test_payment_ui_cog_loads_without_admin_chat_cog` in `test_payment_cog_split.py` that validates `PaymentUICog.cog_load()` works with a `FakeBot` that has no `admin_chat_cog` attribute. Closes FLAG-015, correctness (v4), all_locations (v4), callers (v4). (2) **Restored unified atomic batch semantics via a new transient `awaiting_admin_init` state.** All `initiate_batch_payment` entries (verified + unverified) now go through ONE `create_admin_payment_intents_batch` call \u2014 true all-or-none single-DB-call semantics matching the brief's fail_to_pass test. Verified entries are inserted with `status='awaiting_admin_init'`; unverified with `status='awaiting_wallet'`. `awaiting_admin_init` is added to the CHECK constraint (Step 1), silently ignored by the state-machine dispatch (Step 7 \u2014 new unit test `test_state_machine_silently_ignores_awaiting_admin_init` asserts posting a Solana address never reopens the test path), and handled by the orphan sweep as a new case (e): stale `awaiting_admin_init` intents older than 5 minutes with no `final_payment_id` are cancelled (fail-closed, no payment_requests cleanup needed because no payment row was ever created). After the atomic batch insert succeeds, verified entries iterate through the existing `_gate_existing_intent` helper (unified with the test-receipt-positive path) to create their payment and transition to `awaiting_admin_approval`. Added `test_initiate_batch_payment_verified_fan_out_transitions_to_awaiting_admin_approval` and `test_initiate_batch_payment_fan_out_crash_leaves_awaiting_admin_init_for_sweep`. Closes FLAG-016, issue_hints (v4), scope (v4). `_gate_fresh_intent_atomic` stays in place for the SINGLE `initiate_payment` verified path (no batch wrapper); batch exclusively uses `_gate_existing_intent` for fan-out. No changes to Phases 1-3 structure, no changes to `main.py`, no changes to `test_payment_cog_split.py` or `test_scheduler.py` harnesses.",

  "signals": {
    "iteration": 5,
    "idea": "Identity-based routing for admin_chat with pending-recipient state machine, batch payment creation, admin DM approval gate, auto-skip test for verified wallets, and wallet upsert tooling.\n\nARCHITECTURAL CHANGE \u2014 identity-based router replaces content-based message classification. After this megaplan lands, admin_chat message handling routes entirely by WHO the author is, not by WHAT they said:\n\n1. If author is ADMIN_USER_ID \u2192 full agent path (Claude with all tools including new ones). The agent has access to query tools (new, read-only) and action tools (new initiate_payment batch variant, new upsert_wallet_for_user). System prompt softly guides the agent to use query tools for state questions (not strict enforcement \u2014 the admin can correct hallucinations; money cannot move without an explicit tool call so the safety is structural).\n\n2. If author has an active non-terminal row in admin_payment_intents (a pending payment recipient) \u2192 pure state machine. No LLM in the loop. The state machine reads the message text and routes based on the intent's current state. Two states matter:\n   - awaiting_wallet: parse message for a Solana-address-shaped string (base58, 32-44 chars, proper byte length). If found, register the wallet (verified_at=NULL), trigger test payment. If not found, ignore silently (no spamming).\n   - awaiting_test_receipt_confirmation (NEW STATE): parse message for confirmation keywords ('confirmed', 'received', 'got it', 'yes', 'yep', 'confirm', '\ud83d\udc4d'), negative keywords ('no', 'didnt', 'not received', 'missing', 'nothing'), or ambiguous. On confirmation \u2192 mark wallet_registry.verified_at=now, transition intent to queue the real payment. On negative \u2192 tag admin in thread with full context (tx signature, recipient wallet, intent id). On ambiguous \u2192 ignore the first ambiguous message; tag admin on the second.\n\n3. Otherwise \u2192 fall through (the admin_chat cog does nothing; other cogs like grants/gating/logging handle what they handle).\n\nRECIPIENT-FACING FLOW CHANGES:\n\n- First-ever payment to a new wallet: recipient posts wallet (1 text interaction) \u2192 bot sends 0.002 SOL test \u2192 bot posts 'Please check your wallet and reply confirmed when you see it' \u2192 recipient replies with confirmation text (1 text interaction) \u2192 state machine marks wallet verified \u2192 real payment auto-queues \u2192 admin DM approval gate fires \u2192 admin clicks \u2192 real payment sends. RECIPIENT TOTAL: 2 text interactions.\n- Subsequent payments to a now-verified wallet: skip test entirely. Bot creates real payment \u2192 admin DM approval \u2192 admin clicks \u2192 send. RECIPIENT TOTAL: 0 interactions.\n- Drop the existing PaymentConfirmView button for admin_chat real payments. The admin DM is now the sole real-payment gate. PaymentUICog.send_confirmation_request should no longer fire for producer='admin_chat' real payments. It still fires for grants (grants is unaffected by this megaplan; keeps its own flow).\n\nNEW TOOLS FOR THE ADMIN AGENT:\n\nA) query_payment_state(payment_id=None, user_id=None) \u2192 returns canonical DB state for a payment or all recent payments for a user. Read-only.\nB) query_wallet_state(user_id) \u2192 returns wallet_registry rows for a user (address, verified_at, created_at). Read-only.\nC) list_recent_payments(producer=None, user_id=None, limit=20) \u2192 returns recent payment_requests rows with redacted wallets. Read-only.\nD) initiate_batch_payment(payments=[{recipient_user_id, amount_sol, reason?}, ...]) \u2192 creates N admin_payment_intents atomically in a single DB transaction. Each flows through the normal per-payment mechanical pipeline: if wallet unverified, runs the test \u2192 receipt confirmation cycle; once verified, real payment auto-queues; admin DM approval gate fires individually PER payment (one DM per payment, not per batch). If any intent creation fails, roll back all.\nE) upsert_wallet_for_user(user_id, wallet_address, chain='solana', reason?) \u2192 admin-initiated wallet registration. Creates or updates wallet_registry with verified_at=NULL (verification still requires a test payment round-trip). On success, DMs the admin with a confirmation receipt ('wallet for @user set to 8ThP...xyz1, will be verified on next payment'). Does NOT mark verified_at.\n\nADMIN DM APPROVAL GATE:\n\n- Fires ONLY for real (is_test=False) payments under producer='admin_chat'. Grants is unaffected.\n- One DM per payment (even for batches \u2014 16 payments = 16 DMs). The admin clicks Confirm on each.\n- DM message format: clear amount, recipient, wallet (redacted), intent_id, jump link to original thread.\n- On admin click: edit original DM to '\u2705 approved', send follow-up DM 'payment confirmed, sending', post reply in the intent's thread 'Payment sent to @user', delete stale flow messages in the thread via the existing safe_delete_messages primitive.\n- New AdminApprovalView persistent view class, registered on bot startup for recovery across restarts.\n- If admin DM delivery fails (discord.Forbidden, rate limit) \u2192 fail-closed, payment stays in awaiting_admin_approval, log at ERROR level. Do not auto-fall-back to public channel (assumption: DM delivery is reliable in practice; failure is rare enough to be a manual-ops event).\n\nAUTO-SKIP TEST FOR VERIFIED WALLETS:\n\n- When the admin initiates a payment via initiate_payment or initiate_batch_payment, and the recipient has a wallet_registry row with verified_at IS NOT NULL, skip the test payment creation entirely.\n- Go straight to creating the real payment row, auto-queue, trigger admin DM approval.\n- First-time and verified paths share the admin DM approval gate.\n\nHALLUCINATION FIX (softer than originally proposed):\n\n- Add the three query tools (query_payment_state, query_wallet_state, list_recent_payments) to the agent's tool palette.\n- Update the admin agent's system prompt with a new section: 'For questions about the state of payments or wallets, call query_payment_state / query_wallet_state / list_recent_payments FIRST. Do not claim state from memory or channel context.'\n- This is guidance, not enforcement. The agent CAN still hallucinate, but the operator (the admin) is the only audience, can correct, and money cannot move without an explicit tool call (which is visible and auditable).\n- Do NOT add a cog-layer rejection of replies that make state claims without query tool calls \u2014 the user specifically said not to require tool calls.\n\nWHAT THIS MEGAPLAN IS NOT TOUCHING (preserve existing invariants):\n\n- solana_client.py / solana_provider.py \u2014 the rebroadcast loop, priority fees, status.err check, RPC unreachable handling all stay.\n- Hardening pass inventory: per-user-per-day caps, canonical wallet swap defense, idempotency collision detection, WalletUpdateBlockedError, RLS comment, prompt-injection hardening in admin_chat/tools.py (wallet lookups only from wallet_registry), null-recipient fail-closed in PaymentService.confirm_payment.\n- Cleanup inventory: PaymentActor/PRODUCER_FLOWS registry, tx_signature_history column, PaymentWorkerCog + PaymentUICog split, safe_delete_messages primitive.\n- Polish inventory: reconcile_with_chain, dynamic priority fees, /payment-resolve slash command, provider name migration, docs/payments.md, docs/runbook-payments.md, scripts/check_payment_invariants.py, structured tx_confirm_decision logging.\n- Grants cog \u2014 completely unaffected. Grants uses its own thread-scoped listener, has its own flow (test auto-confirmed by bot, recipient clicks button for real payment), and this megaplan does not touch it.\n- The 'approved members can chat with bot' feature \u2014 the _can_user_message_bot path in admin_chat_cog. Under identity-based routing, approved-member messages are no longer forwarded to the agent unless the member is ALSO the ADMIN_USER_ID. This is an intentional scoping decision \u2014 the admin is the sole human who can conversationally interact with the agent. Document this in the plan explicitly so no one is surprised.\n\nSUCCESS CRITERIA:\n\n- Identity router correctly classifies admin, pending recipient, and fallthrough based solely on author identity.\n- Pending recipient state machine handles awaiting_wallet and awaiting_test_receipt_confirmation deterministically with no LLM calls.\n- Test-receipt confirmation flow: recipient's text acknowledgment is the sole gate for marking wallet_registry.verified_at (not on-chain confirmation alone).\n- Negative / ambiguous recipient responses escalate to the admin via thread tag, not silent failure.\n- 24-hour timeout on awaiting_test_receipt_confirmation \u2192 escalate to manual_review + admin DM.\n- New tools (query_*, initiate_batch_payment, upsert_wallet_for_user) are admin-only and correctly scoped.\n- initiate_batch_payment creates all intents atomically or none (DB transaction).\n- Auto-skip test path correctly bypasses the test phase for already-verified wallets.\n- Admin DM approval gate fires exactly once per real admin_chat payment, never for tests, never for grants.\n- AdminApprovalView is persistent-safe across bot restarts.\n- PaymentConfirmView button no longer fires for admin_chat real payments (grants-only now).\n- No regression in existing hardening/cleanup/polish invariants \u2014 all existing tests pass.\n- New tests cover: identity router branches, state machine state transitions, wallet regex parsing, confirmation keyword matching, batch tool atomicity, upsert_wallet_for_user admin check, auto-skip verified path, admin DM approval view persistence and click handling.",

        "resolution": "Addressed all 19 gate flags in a focused revision (no re-scope). (3) Step 6 drops `_is_directed_at_bot` gating for ADMIN_USER_ID \u2014 admin messages reach the agent unconditionally (plain channel messages included). (4) Step 5 replaces the whitespace-only wallet parser with a tolerant regex that strips markdown/punctuation delimiters before validating candidates. (6) Step 1.3 adds a second `receipt_prompt_message_id` column so safe-delete can clear BOTH the wallet prompt AND the receipt prompt. (7) Step 13 verified-wallet batch entries now skip `awaiting_test` entirely \u2014 they land directly in `awaiting_admin_approval` at intent-creation time. (8) Step 15 adds the five new tool names to `ADMIN_ONLY_TOOLS` so the module-level exhaustiveness assert doesn't fire; Step 16 extends `agent.py`'s `admin_user_id` injection to cover `initiate_batch_payment` and `upsert_wallet_for_user`. (9) Step 2.5 excludes `manual_review` from active-intent lookups AND new Step 20 adds a `resolve_admin_intent` tool as the operator resolution surface \u2014 `manual_review` intents no longer block future initiations and admin can cancel/complete them explicitly. (10) Step 1.4 updates the unique partial index to exclude `manual_review`. Rewrote Execution Order note to call out the Phase 2 triple as a single interlocked change.         "resolution": "Revision 4 applies three surgical fixes to address iteration-3 gate flags: (1) **Eliminated the `awaiting_wallet` placeholder for verified-wallet fast path.** Step 9 now defines TWO helpers: `_gate_existing_intent` (for test-receipt positive, intent already exists \u2192 request_payment \u2192 atomic update with status+final_payment_id \u2192 admin DM) and `_gate_fresh_intent_atomic` (for auto-skip, no intent yet \u2192 duplicate check \u2192 request_payment \u2192 atomic INSERT of intent with status='awaiting_admin_approval' AND final_payment_id in one call \u2192 admin DM).         "resolution": "Revision 5 applies two surgical fixes to resolve the iteration-4 concerns: (1) **Inverted the orphan-sweep dependency** \u2014 moved `_reconcile_admin_chat_orphans` OUT of `AdminChatCog` and INTO `PaymentUICog` itself.         Settled decisions (verify the executor implemented these correctly):
- SD-001: Admin DM gate uses existing PaymentActorKind.ADMIN_DM; no new enum value. (Carried. Verified at payment_service.py:30 with authorization at :539-546.)
- SD-002: Identity routing by author.id only; no _is_directed_at_bot gate for ADMIN_USER_ID. (Rev-2 fix for FLAG-003. Admin plain-channel messages reach the agent.)
- SD-003: Grants flow is strictly out of scope; grants_cog.py, grants PaymentConfirmView flow, main.py, tests/test_payment_cog_split.py harness, tests/test_scheduler.py harness all untouched. (Brief invariant; preserved across all revisions.)
- SD-004: Batch tool upper bound: 1..20 entries per call. (Matches brief's 16-payment example with headroom.)
- SD-005: 24h timeout sweep lives in AdminChatCog at 15-minute intervals. (AdminChatCog owns intent lifecycle; above the ≥5-min constraint.)
- SD-006: AdminApprovalView click handler posts 'queued for sending' (NOT 'Payment sent'); existing handle_payment_result is the sole source of the 'Payment sent.' post. (Rev-2 fix for FLAG-005 / correctness-1. confirm_payment only transitions pending_confirmation→queued.)
- SD-007: receipt_prompt_message_id is a separate new column; safe_delete_messages clears both prompt ids. (Rev-2 fix for correctness-3.)
- SD-008: Wallet parser uses tolerant delimiter regex with is_valid_solana_address validation. (Rev-2 fix for issue_hints-2.)
- SD-009: ADMIN_ONLY_TOOLS, _ADMIN_IDENTITY_INJECTED_TOOLS, and all six new-tool schemas land in the same commit to prevent module-level assert failures. (Rev-2/Rev-3 infrastructure pattern.)
- SD-010: manual_review remains a BLOCKING state across get_active_intent_for_recipient, list_active_intents, has_active_payment_or_intent, and the unique partial index. Admin clears via resolve_admin_intent. (Rev-3 revert of Rev-2 over-correction. Preserves fail-closed semantics.)
- SD-011: resolve_admin_intent: cancel-only (no resolution parameter), admin-only via both sets, explicit admin DM, cascade-cancels linked test_payment_id and final_payment_id via existing cancel_payment, refuses non-cancellable linked payments (directs operator to /payment-resolve). (Rev-4 fix for FLAG-011, FLAG-014, correctness-2.)
- SD-012: Single initiate_payment verified path uses _gate_fresh_intent_atomic: payment-first ordering with atomic intent create (status='awaiting_admin_approval' AND final_payment_id set in ONE insert, client-side uuid4 for intent_id). No placeholder state. (Rev-4 fix for FLAG-013.)
- SD-013: PaymentConfirmView is NEVER the crash-recovery fallback for new-flow admin_chat real payments. Crash recovery is handled by the orphan sweep which runs BEFORE _register_pending_confirmation_views. (Rev-4 fix for FLAG-012.)
- SD-014: Orphan-payment reconciliation sweep lives in PaymentUICog._reconcile_admin_chat_orphans — NOT in AdminChatCog. Uses only self.db_handler, self.payment_service, self.bot, self._send_admin_approval_dm. No cross-cog dependency. main.py, tests/test_payment_cog_split.py, and tests/test_scheduler.py are NOT modified. A regression test `test_payment_ui_cog_loads_without_admin_chat_cog` validates this. (Rev-5 fix for FLAG-015. Dependency inversion eliminates bootstrap-order problem.)
- SD-015: initiate_batch_payment uses unified atomic insert for all entries (verified + unverified) via a single create_admin_payment_intents_batch call. Verified entries start in awaiting_admin_init (transient new state); unverified in awaiting_wallet. After the atomic insert, verified entries iterate through _gate_existing_intent (shared with test-receipt-positive) to transition to awaiting_admin_approval with final_payment_id set and fire admin DMs. This satisfies the brief's test_initiate_batch_payment_atomic_all_or_none. (Rev-5 fix for FLAG-016.)
- SD-016: awaiting_admin_init is a new transient non-routable state. Added to the CHECK constraint and silently ignored by the state-machine dispatch (same as awaiting_test, awaiting_admin_approval). A dedicated unit test asserts that posting a Solana address while in awaiting_admin_init never reopens the test-payment path. (Prevents any routing bug analogous to Rev-3's awaiting_wallet placeholder issue.)
- SD-017: has_active_payment_or_intent at db_handler.py:1575-1601 is NOT modified. Consistent with SD-010. (No cross-helper drift.)
- SD-018: PaymentUICog must have a @tasks.loop(minutes=5) _orphan_sweep_loop that periodically calls _reconcile_admin_chat_orphans during normal uptime, not just at cog_load. Start the loop in cog_load after the initial one-shot sweep; stop in cog_unload. Wrap the loop body in try/except. (Execution-time requirement to address iter 5 FLAG-017 / correctness / all_locations / scope / callers. Bounds stranded awaiting_admin_init cleanup to <5 minutes during uptime.)

        - Verify each success criterion explicitly.
        - Trust executor evidence by default. Dig deeper only where the git diff, `execution_audit.json`, or vague notes make the claim ambiguous.
        - Each criterion has a `priority` (`must`, `should`, or `info`). Apply these rules:
          - `must` criteria are hard gates. A `must` criterion that fails means `needs_rework`.
          - `should` criteria are quality targets. If the spirit is met but the letter is not, mark `pass` with evidence explaining the gap. Only mark `fail` if the intent was clearly missed. A `should` failure alone does NOT require `needs_rework`.
          - `info` criteria are for human reference. Mark them `waived` with a note — do not evaluate them.
          - If a criterion (any priority) cannot be verified in this context (e.g., requires manual testing or runtime observation), mark it `waived` with an explanation.
        - Set `review_verdict` to `needs_rework` only when at least one `must` criterion fails or actual implementation work is incomplete. Use `approved` when all `must` criteria pass, even if some `should` criteria are flagged.
        - The decisions listed above were settled at the gate stage. Verify that the executor implemented each settled decision correctly. Flag deviations from these decisions, but do not question the decisions themselves.
        - baseline_test_failures in finalize.json lists tests that were already failing before execution. Do not flag these as rework items unless the executor introduced new failures in those same tests.
        - Cross-reference each task's `files_changed` and `commands_run` against the git diff and any audit findings.
        - Review every `sense_check` explicitly and treat perfunctory acknowledgments as a reason to dig deeper.
        - Follow this JSON shape exactly:

        Idea:
Identity-based routing for admin_chat with pending-recipient state machine, batch payment creation, admin DM approval gate, auto-skip test for verified wallets, and wallet upsert tooling.

ARCHITECTURAL CHANGE — identity-based router replaces content-based message classification. After this megaplan lands, admin_chat message handling routes entirely by WHO the author is, not by WHAT they said:

1. If author is ADMIN_USER_ID → full agent path (Claude with all tools including new ones). The agent has access to query tools (new, read-only) and action tools (new initiate_payment batch variant, new upsert_wallet_for_user). System prompt softly guides the agent to use query tools for state questions (not strict enforcement — the admin can correct hallucinations; money cannot move without an explicit tool call so the safety is structural).

2. If author has an active non-terminal row in admin_payment_intents (a pending payment recipient) → pure state machine. No LLM in the loop. The state machine reads the message text and routes based on the intent's current state. Two states matter:
   - awaiting_wallet: parse message for a Solana-address-shaped string (base58, 32-44 chars, proper byte length). If found, register the wallet (verified_at=NULL), trigger test payment. If not found, ignore silently (no spamming).
   - awaiting_test_receipt_confirmation (NEW STATE): parse message for confirmation keywords ('confirmed', 'received', 'got it', 'yes', 'yep', 'confirm', '👍'), negative keywords ('no', 'didnt', 'not received', 'missing', 'nothing'), or ambiguous. On confirmation → mark wallet_registry.verified_at=now, transition intent to queue the real payment. On negative → tag admin in thread with full context (tx signature, recipient wallet, intent id). On ambiguous → ignore the first ambiguous message; tag admin on the second.

3. Otherwise → fall through (the admin_chat cog does nothing; other cogs like grants/gating/logging handle what they handle).

RECIPIENT-FACING FLOW CHANGES:

- First-ever payment to a new wallet: recipient posts wallet (1 text interaction) → bot sends 0.002 SOL test → bot posts 'Please check your wallet and reply confirmed when you see it' → recipient replies with confirmation text (1 text interaction) → state machine marks wallet verified → real payment auto-queues → admin DM approval gate fires → admin clicks → real payment sends. RECIPIENT TOTAL: 2 text interactions.
- Subsequent payments to a now-verified wallet: skip test entirely. Bot creates real payment → admin DM approval → admin clicks → send. RECIPIENT TOTAL: 0 interactions.
- Drop the existing PaymentConfirmView button for admin_chat real payments. The admin DM is now the sole real-payment gate. PaymentUICog.send_confirmation_request should no longer fire for producer='admin_chat' real payments. It still fires for grants (grants is unaffected by this megaplan; keeps its own flow).

NEW TOOLS FOR THE ADMIN AGENT:

A) query_payment_state(payment_id=None, user_id=None) → returns canonical DB state for a payment or all recent payments for a user. Read-only.
B) query_wallet_state(user_id) → returns wallet_registry rows for a user (address, verified_at, created_at). Read-only.
C) list_recent_payments(producer=None, user_id=None, limit=20) → returns recent payment_requests rows with redacted wallets. Read-only.
D) initiate_batch_payment(payments=[{recipient_user_id, amount_sol, reason?}, ...]) → creates N admin_payment_intents atomically in a single DB transaction. Each flows through the normal per-payment mechanical pipeline: if wallet unverified, runs the test → receipt confirmation cycle; once verified, real payment auto-queues; admin DM approval gate fires individually PER payment (one DM per payment, not per batch). If any intent creation fails, roll back all.
E) upsert_wallet_for_user(user_id, wallet_address, chain='solana', reason?) → admin-initiated wallet registration. Creates or updates wallet_registry with verified_at=NULL (verification still requires a test payment round-trip). On success, DMs the admin with a confirmation receipt ('wallet for @user set to 8ThP...xyz1, will be verified on next payment'). Does NOT mark verified_at.

ADMIN DM APPROVAL GATE:

- Fires ONLY for real (is_test=False) payments under producer='admin_chat'. Grants is unaffected.
- One DM per payment (even for batches — 16 payments = 16 DMs). The admin clicks Confirm on each.
- DM message format: clear amount, recipient, wallet (redacted), intent_id, jump link to original thread.
- On admin click: edit original DM to '✅ approved', send follow-up DM 'payment confirmed, sending', post reply in the intent's thread 'Payment sent to @user', delete stale flow messages in the thread via the existing safe_delete_messages primitive.
- New AdminApprovalView persistent view class, registered on bot startup for recovery across restarts.
- If admin DM delivery fails (discord.Forbidden, rate limit) → fail-closed, payment stays in awaiting_admin_approval, log at ERROR level. Do not auto-fall-back to public channel (assumption: DM delivery is reliable in practice; failure is rare enough to be a manual-ops event).

AUTO-SKIP TEST FOR VERIFIED WALLETS:

- When the admin initiates a payment via initiate_payment or initiate_batch_payment, and the recipient has a wallet_registry row with verified_at IS NOT NULL, skip the test payment creation entirely.
- Go straight to creating the real payment row, auto-queue, trigger admin DM approval.
- First-time and verified paths share the admin DM approval gate.

HALLUCINATION FIX (softer than originally proposed):

- Add the three query tools (query_payment_state, query_wallet_state, list_recent_payments) to the agent's tool palette.
- Update the admin agent's system prompt with a new section: 'For questions about the state of payments or wallets, call query_payment_state / query_wallet_state / list_recent_payments FIRST. Do not claim state from memory or channel context.'
- This is guidance, not enforcement. The agent CAN still hallucinate, but the operator (the admin) is the only audience, can correct, and money cannot move without an explicit tool call (which is visible and auditable).
- Do NOT add a cog-layer rejection of replies that make state claims without query tool calls — the user specifically said not to require tool calls.

WHAT THIS MEGAPLAN IS NOT TOUCHING (preserve existing invariants):

- solana_client.py / solana_provider.py — the rebroadcast loop, priority fees, status.err check, RPC unreachable handling all stay.
- Hardening pass inventory: per-user-per-day caps, canonical wallet swap defense, idempotency collision detection, WalletUpdateBlockedError, RLS comment, prompt-injection hardening in admin_chat/tools.py (wallet lookups only from wallet_registry), null-recipient fail-closed in PaymentService.confirm_payment.

- The 'approved members can chat with bot' feature — the _can_user_message_bot path in admin_chat_cog. Under identity-based routing, approved-member messages are no longer forwarded to the agent unless the member is ALSO the ADMIN_USER_ID. This is an intentional scoping decision — the admin is the sole human who can conversationally interact with the agent. Document this in the plan explicitly so no one is surprised.

SUCCESS CRITERIA:

        # Implementation Plan: Identity-Based Admin Chat Routing + Admin-DM Approval Gate (Revision 5)

## Overview
Refactor `admin_chat` from content-based classification to strict identity-based routing (admin → agent, active-intent recipient → deterministic state machine, else → fallthrough). Gate recipient `verified_at` on a text-ack of the on-chain test. Replace `PaymentConfirmView` with a DM-only `AdminApprovalView` for `producer='admin_chat'` NEW-flow real payments, authorized via the already-existing `PaymentActorKind.ADMIN_DM`. Add 5 new agent tools plus `resolve_admin_intent`. Auto-skip the test for verified wallets. Add a 24h timeout sweep. Grants + all hardening/cleanup/polish invariants untouched.

**Revision 5 applies two surgical fixes on top of Revision 4's 14 resolved flags**, addressing the two genuinely distinct iteration-4 concerns:

1. **Invert the orphan-sweep dependency.** Move `_reconcile_admin_chat_orphan_payments` OUT of `AdminChatCog` and INTO `PaymentUICog` itself. The sweep only touches `self.db_handler`, `self.payment_service`, `self.bot.fetch_user`, and `self._send_admin_approval_dm` — all already accessible from `PaymentUICog`. No cross-cog accessor, no main.py bootstrap changes, no test harness updates, no `FakeBot` additions. Closes **FLAG-015, correctness (v4), all_locations (v4), callers (v4)**.

2. **Restore unified atomic batch semantics via a new transient `awaiting_admin_init` state.** All `initiate_batch_payment` entries (verified + unverified) go through ONE `create_admin_payment_intents_batch` call. Verified entries get `status='awaiting_admin_init'`; unverified get `'awaiting_wallet'`. `awaiting_admin_init` is added to the CHECK constraint AND to the state-machine dispatch as a silent-ignore state (like `awaiting_test`, `awaiting_admin_approval`) so it can never reopen the wallet-collection path. After the atomic insert succeeds, verified entries iterate through `_gate_existing_intent` (already defined in Step 9 for the test-receipt-positive path) to transition to `awaiting_admin_approval` + create payment + fire DM. The orphan sweep gains a fifth case: any `awaiting_admin_init` intent older than a grace window with no `final_payment_id` → cancel (no payment was ever created — fail-closed). Closes **FLAG-016, issue_hints (v4), scope (v4)**.

Everything outside these two fixes carries over from Revision 4 verbatim: schema (with the `awaiting_admin_init` addition), DB helpers, producer_flows authorization, state-aware restart filter for legacy `awaiting_confirmation` rows, identity router, parsers, test-receipt handlers, `_gate_existing_intent` / `_gate_fresh_intent_atomic`, `AdminApprovalView`, new agent tools, ADMIN_ONLY_TOOLS / _ADMIN_IDENTITY_INJECTED_TOOLS, 24h timeout sweep, resolve_admin_intent cascade cancellation.

Evidence (unchanged from Rev-4): `PaymentActorKind.ADMIN_DM` at `payment_service.py:30`; `_authorize_actor` at `:539-546`; `PRODUCER_FLOWS['admin_chat']` at `producer_flows.py:21-29`; `PaymentUICog._register_pending_confirmation_views` at `payment_ui_cog.py:110-130`; `db_handler.cancel_payment` at `:2402-2420`; `create_admin_payment_intent` at `:1805-1819`; unique partial index at `sql/admin_payment_intents.sql:47-49`. **New Rev-5 evidence:** `main.py:257-274` loads `PaymentUICog` before `AdminChatCog`; `tests/test_payment_cog_split.py:58-63` and `tests/test_scheduler.py:423-431` exercise `PaymentUICog.cog_load()` with no admin-chat cog present. This confirms inverting the dependency is the only path that doesn't break existing callers.

Scope boundaries (unchanged): do NOT touch `solana_client.py`/`solana_provider.py`, `grants_cog.py`, `main.py` startup ordering, `tests/test_payment_cog_split.py` harness, hardening/cleanup/polish invariants. `MEMBER_SYSTEM_PROMPT`, `_can_user_message_bot`, `_is_directed_at_bot` stay as dead code. `has_active_payment_or_intent` unchanged. `manual_review` stays blocking.

   - Validate every element (all-or-none): `recipient_user_id > 0`, `amount_sol > 0`, no active duplicate via `get_active_intent_for_recipient`. On any failure → return error with ZERO DB writes.

The helper creates the `payment_requests` row and transitions the intent to `awaiting_admin_approval` + `final_payment_id`. The intent row already exists from the atomic batch insert — the helper just updates it. If a verified entry's gate transition fails mid-way (network error, payment service down, etc.), the intent stays in `awaiting_admin_init` and the orphan sweep picks it up on the next run to cancel it (fail-closed).

On restart, the orphan sweep's fifth case (Step 18) finds `awaiting_admin_init` intents older than a grace window (e.g., 5 minutes — enough to survive a transient startup delay but short enough to avoid user confusion) and cancels them. No orphan `payment_requests` rows exist because the payment is only created AFTER the intent is already in place.
   - **Atomicity semantics documented in the tool description and test:** atomicity means "all N intent rows persisted or zero intent rows persisted, in ONE DB call". Per-entry fan-out is a necessarily non-atomic follow-up phase (each entry needs its own `payment_requests` row). The orphan sweep is the recovery mechanism. A 16-payment batch produces at most 16 admin DMs (mid-fan-out crash may produce fewer; the orphan sweep cancels the rest and the admin re-invokes for those).

   async def cog_load(self):
       await self._reconcile_admin_chat_orphans()        # NEW — Rev-5 Step 18
       await self._register_pending_confirmation_views() # Rev-4 Step 4 state-aware filter
       await self._register_pending_admin_approval_views() # Rev-4 Step 10.3
   ```
   The orphan sweep runs first, so by the time the view-registration passes execute, every `pending_confirmation` admin_chat real payment is either (a) wired to an intent in `awaiting_admin_approval` OR (b) cancelled. And every stale `awaiting_admin_init` intent is either (a) completed (transitioned + DM fired) OR (b) cancelled.
3. **Sweep logic** (six cases — Rev-5 adds case e and handles `awaiting_admin_init`):
   ```python
   async def _reconcile_admin_chat_orphans(self):
       writable_guild_ids = self._get_writable_guild_ids()
       # PHASE 1: pending_confirmation admin_chat real payments
       pending = self.payment_service.get_pending_confirmation_payments(guild_ids=writable_guild_ids)
       for payment in pending:
           if payment.get('producer') != 'admin_chat' or payment.get('is_test'):
               continue
           metadata = payment.get('metadata') or {}
           intent_id = metadata.get('intent_id')
           intent = self.db_handler.get_admin_payment_intent(intent_id, payment['guild_id']) if intent_id else None
           if intent is None:
               intent = self.db_handler.find_admin_chat_intent_by_payment_id(payment['payment_id'])
           if intent is None:
               # (a) AUTO-SKIP CRASH (single initiate path): no intent. Cancel orphan.
               self.db_handler.cancel_payment(payment['payment_id'], guild_id=payment['guild_id'],
                                              reason='orphan admin_chat real payment on startup — no intent')
               logger.error("[PaymentUICog] Cancelled orphan admin_chat real payment %s (no intent)", payment['payment_id'])
               continue
           intent_status = (intent.get('status') or '').lower()
           if intent_status == 'awaiting_admin_approval' and intent.get('final_payment_id') == payment['payment_id']:
               # (b) Already wired. _register_pending_admin_approval_views handles it.
               continue
           if intent_status == 'awaiting_confirmation':
               # (c) LEGACY in-flight. Leave for _register_pending_confirmation_views.
               continue
           if intent_status in ('awaiting_test_receipt_confirmation', 'awaiting_admin_init'):
               # (d) TEST-RECEIPT or BATCH-FAN-OUT crash window: intent exists but
               # never got its final_payment_id update. Complete step B and fire DM.
               updated = self.db_handler.update_admin_payment_intent(intent['intent_id'], {
                   'status': 'awaiting_admin_approval',
                   'final_payment_id': payment['payment_id'],
               }, intent['guild_id'])
               if updated:
                   await self._send_admin_approval_dm(payment)
                   logger.info("[PaymentUICog] Recovered crash-window intent %s", intent['intent_id'])
               continue
           # Anomalous: cancel orphan, leave intent for ops review.
           self.db_handler.cancel_payment(payment['payment_id'], guild_id=payment['guild_id'],
                                          reason=f'orphan admin_chat real payment on startup — intent in {intent_status}')
           logger.error("[PaymentUICog] Cancelled anomalous admin_chat real payment %s (intent %s in %s)",
                        payment['payment_id'], intent['intent_id'], intent_status)
       # PHASE 2 (NEW Rev-5): awaiting_admin_init intents that never got a payment row.
       # These are batch verified-fan-out crashes where the crash happened BEFORE request_payment.
       cutoff = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(minutes=5)).isoformat()
       stale_init = self.db_handler.list_stale_awaiting_admin_init_intents(cutoff)
       for intent in stale_init:
           # Defensive: if final_payment_id is set, the intent was actually wired between
           # the stale query and this iteration — skip.
           if intent.get('final_payment_id'):
               continue
           # (e) Stale awaiting_admin_init with no payment row exists. Cancel the intent
           # (fail-closed). No payment_requests cleanup needed because no payment exists.
           self.db_handler.update_admin_payment_intent(intent['intent_id'], {
               'status': 'cancelled',
           }, intent['guild_id'])
           logger.error("[PaymentUICog] Cancelled stale awaiting_admin_init intent %s (batch fan-out crash)", intent['intent_id'])
   ```
4. **Defensive `bot.payment_ui_cog` attribute:** since `_gate_existing_intent` (in `admin_chat_cog.py`) references `bot.payment_ui_cog._send_admin_approval_dm(...)`, and this call happens only AFTER the orphan sweep has run (production flow), there is no initialization-order problem. The attribute is set in `PaymentUICog.__init__` via `self.bot.payment_ui_cog = self` (Rev-4 kept this from the original file).
5. **Extend** the existing `AdminChatCog._reconcile_active_intents` walker to handle `awaiting_test_receipt_confirmation` (replay via `_handle_pending_recipient_message`) and to log counts for `awaiting_admin_approval` / `awaiting_admin_init` / `manual_review`. This is the ONLY Step 18 change that stays in `AdminChatCog` — it's pure intent-lifecycle reconciliation, not payment-row reconciliation.
6. **Modify** `_reconcile_intent_history` to call `_handle_pending_recipient_message(message, refreshed_intent)`.
7. **Delete** `_classify_payment_reply` and `_check_pending_payment_reply` once grep confirms no callers.

   - Explicit admin DM.

Tasks T3, T5, T12, T14, T18 have no dependencies and can be done in any order or in parallel within a phase.\n\nThe single highest-leverage execution-time addition is the @tasks.loop(minutes=5) periodic orphan sweep in T16 \u2014 the gate marked this as a required directive in its warnings (closes FLAG-017 and the iteration-5 callers/correctness/all_locations/scope flags). Without it, stale awaiting_admin_init intents only clear at restart, which is unacceptable because they block fresh initiations for the affected recipient via has_active_payment_or_intent / get_active_intent_for_recipient.\n\nThe Rev-5 design is built around ONE critical insight: the orphan sweep MUST live in PaymentUICog itself, not AdminChatCog. Do not be tempted to move it back \u2014 main.py loads PaymentUICog before AdminChatCog and tests instantiate PaymentUICog with no admin_chat_cog at all. The dedicated regression test test_payment_ui_cog_loads_without_admin_chat_cog (T19) catches accidental regression on this.\n\nTwo helpers, one flow each: _gate_existing_intent (T9) is shared by test-receipt-positive AND batch verified fan-out \u2014 the intent already exists in a non-terminal state. _gate_fresh_intent_atomic (T9) is ONLY for the single execute_initiate_payment verified path \u2014 no intent yet, atomic create with status+final_payment_id in one insert. Do not cross these wires.\n\nThe atomicity contract for initiate_batch_payment (T13) is the single DB call. After that call, fan-out is per-entry and non-atomic by necessity (each entry needs its own payment_requests row); the orphan sweep is the recovery mechanism for mid-fan-out crashes. The brief's fail_to_pass test test_initiate_batch_payment_atomic_all_or_none asserts this exact contract.\n\nWhen implementing T19, expect to delete a substantial portion of test_admin_payments.py \u2014 every test that mocks _classify_payment_reply or asserts the awaiting_confirmation\u2192final-payment transition is now obsolete. The admin clears it via resolve_admin_intent which cascade-cancels. Do not touch get_active_intent_for_recipient / list_active_intents / has_active_payment_or_intent.\n\nThe dead-code preservation matters: MEMBER_SYSTEM_PROMPT, _can_user_message_bot, _is_directed_at_bot stay in place but become unreachable. Document with a brief comment, do not delete.\n\nFinal test phase (T20): if anything fails, read the error and fix the root cause. Do NOT skip, xfail, or weaken assertions to make tests pass.   "changes_summary": "Revision 5 applies two surgical fixes to resolve the iteration-4 concerns: (1) **Inverted the orphan-sweep dependency** \u2014 moved `_reconcile_admin_chat_orphans` OUT of `AdminChatCog` and INTO `PaymentUICog` itself. The sweep only needs `self.db_handler`, `self.payment_service`, `self.bot`, and `self._send_admin_approval_dm`, all already accessible from the UI cog. This eliminates the cross-cog ordering problem entirely: no `bot.admin_chat_cog.reconcile_orphan_payments_for_ui_cog()` accessor, no `main.py` bootstrap reorder, no test harness changes, no `FakeBot` additions. Added a critical regression test `test_payment_ui_cog_loads_without_admin_chat_cog` in `test_payment_cog_split.py` that validates `PaymentUICog.cog_load()` works with a `FakeBot` that has no `admin_chat_cog` attribute. Closes FLAG-015, correctness (v4), all_locations (v4), callers (v4). (2) **Restored unified atomic batch semantics via a new transient `awaiting_admin_init` state.** All `initiate_batch_payment` entries (verified + unverified) now go through ONE `create_admin_payment_intents_batch` call \u2014 true all-or-none single-DB-call semantics matching the brief's fail_to_pass test. Verified entries are inserted with `status='awaiting_admin_init'`; unverified with `status='awaiting_wallet'`. `awaiting_admin_init` is added to the CHECK constraint (Step 1), silently ignored by the state-machine dispatch (Step 7 \u2014 new unit test `test_state_machine_silently_ignores_awaiting_admin_init` asserts posting a Solana address never reopens the test path), and handled by the orphan sweep as a new case (e): stale `awaiting_admin_init` intents older than 5 minutes with no `final_payment_id` are cancelled (fail-closed, no payment_requests cleanup needed because no payment row was ever created). After the atomic batch insert succeeds, verified entries iterate through the existing `_gate_existing_intent` helper (unified with the test-receipt-positive path) to create their payment and transition to `awaiting_admin_approval`. Added `test_initiate_batch_payment_verified_fan_out_transitions_to_awaiting_admin_approval` and `test_initiate_batch_payment_fan_out_crash_leaves_awaiting_admin_init_for_sweep`. Closes FLAG-016, issue_hints (v4), scope (v4). `_gate_fresh_intent_atomic` stays in place for the SINGLE `initiate_payment` verified path (no batch wrapper); batch exclusively uses `_gate_existing_intent` for fan-out. No changes to Phases 1-3 structure, no changes to `main.py`, no changes to `test_payment_cog_split.py` or `test_scheduler.py` harnesses.",

  "rationale": "Iteration 5 with score stable at 25.5 (basically unchanged from 26.0 in iter 4), 16 flags resolved cumulatively, plan delta narrowing (90%\u219267%\u219274%\u219263%), zero recurring critiques, and a \"high iteration count\" warning from the gate itself. Seven flag entries (correctness, all_locations, scope, callers, issue_hints, FLAG-017, plus minor alias) all trace back to this single gap: the sweep only runs at `cog_load`, so a mid-fan-out batch crash leaves `awaiting_admin_init` entries stranded until restart. **The fix is trivial** (~10 lines): add `@tasks.loop(minutes=5) _orphan_sweep_loop` to `PaymentUICog` that calls the existing `_reconcile_admin_chat_orphans()`, start in `cog_load` after the initial invocation, stop in `cog_unload`. This is clearly an execution-time detail, not a design-level question \u2014 all the design decisions (dependency inversion, atomic batch insert, transient state, orphan sweep logic) are settled and correct. The issue_hints (v5) \"divergence\" flag is also disputable: the brief explicitly says `initiate_batch_payment` \"creates N admin_payment_intents atomically... each flows through the normal per-payment mechanical pipeline\", which matches the Rev-5 design (atomic insert, then per-entry pipeline). `awaiting_admin_init` is a transient internal state that exists only during the pipeline phase; from the outside observer the intent lands in `awaiting_admin_approval` as required. Further iteration at this point risks introducing new concerns (as iter 2 and iter 4 both demonstrated) without meaningfully improving the outcome. Ship with an explicit execution-time directive to add the periodic loop.",

    "iteration": 5,
    "idea": "Identity-based routing for admin_chat with pending-recipient state machine, batch payment creation, admin DM approval gate, auto-skip test for verified wallets, and wallet upsert tooling.\n\nARCHITECTURAL CHANGE \u2014 identity-based router replaces content-based message classification. After this megaplan lands, admin_chat message handling routes entirely by WHO the author is, not by WHAT they said:\n\n1. If author is ADMIN_USER_ID \u2192 full agent path (Claude with all tools including new ones). The agent has access to query tools (new, read-only) and action tools (new initiate_payment batch variant, new upsert_wallet_for_user). System prompt softly guides the agent to use query tools for state questions (not strict enforcement \u2014 the admin can correct hallucinations; money cannot move without an explicit tool call so the safety is structural).\n\n2. If author has an active non-terminal row in admin_payment_intents (a pending payment recipient) \u2192 pure state machine. No LLM in the loop. The state machine reads the message text and routes based on the intent's current state. Two states matter:\n   - awaiting_wallet: parse message for a Solana-address-shaped string (base58, 32-44 chars, proper byte length). If found, register the wallet (verified_at=NULL), trigger test payment. If not found, ignore silently (no spamming).\n   - awaiting_test_receipt_confirmation (NEW STATE): parse message for confirmation keywords ('confirmed', 'received', 'got it', 'yes', 'yep', 'confirm', '\ud83d\udc4d'), negative keywords ('no', 'didnt', 'not received', 'missing', 'nothing'), or ambiguous. On confirmation \u2192 mark wallet_registry.verified_at=now, transition intent to queue the real payment. On negative \u2192 tag admin in thread with full context (tx signature, recipient wallet, intent id). On ambiguous \u2192 ignore the first ambiguous message; tag admin on the second.\n\n3. Otherwise \u2192 fall through (the admin_chat cog does nothing; other cogs like grants/gating/logging handle what they handle).\n\nRECIPIENT-FACING FLOW CHANGES:\n\n- First-ever payment to a new wallet: recipient posts wallet (1 text interaction) \u2192 bot sends 0.002 SOL test \u2192 bot posts 'Please check your wallet and reply confirmed when you see it' \u2192 recipient replies with confirmation text (1 text interaction) \u2192 state machine marks wallet verified \u2192 real payment auto-queues \u2192 admin DM approval gate fires \u2192 admin clicks \u2192 real payment sends. RECIPIENT TOTAL: 2 text interactions.\n- Subsequent payments to a now-verified wallet: skip test entirely. Bot creates real payment \u2192 admin DM approval \u2192 admin clicks \u2192 send. RECIPIENT TOTAL: 0 interactions.\n- Drop the existing PaymentConfirmView button for admin_chat real payments. The admin DM is now the sole real-payment gate. PaymentUICog.send_confirmation_request should no longer fire for producer='admin_chat' real payments. It still fires for grants (grants is unaffected by this megaplan; keeps its own flow).\n\nNEW TOOLS FOR THE ADMIN AGENT:\n\nA) query_payment_state(payment_id=None, user_id=None) \u2192 returns canonical DB state for a payment or all recent payments for a user. Read-only.\nB) query_wallet_state(user_id) \u2192 returns wallet_registry rows for a user (address, verified_at, created_at). Read-only.\nC) list_recent_payments(producer=None, user_id=None, limit=20) \u2192 returns recent payment_requests rows with redacted wallets. Read-only.\nD) initiate_batch_payment(payments=[{recipient_user_id, amount_sol, reason?}, ...]) \u2192 creates N admin_payment_intents atomically in a single DB transaction. Each flows through the normal per-payment mechanical pipeline: if wallet unverified, runs the test \u2192 receipt confirmation cycle; once verified, real payment auto-queues; admin DM approval gate fires individually PER payment (one DM per payment, not per batch). If any intent creation fails, roll back all.\nE) upsert_wallet_for_user(user_id, wallet_address, chain='solana', reason?) \u2192 admin-initiated wallet registration. Creates or updates wallet_registry with verified_at=NULL (verification still requires a test payment round-trip). On success, DMs the admin with a confirmation receipt ('wallet for @user set to 8ThP...xyz1, will be verified on next payment'). Does NOT mark verified_at.\n\nADMIN DM APPROVAL GATE:\n\n- Fires ONLY for real (is_test=False) payments under producer='admin_chat'. Grants is unaffected.\n- One DM per payment (even for batches \u2014 16 payments = 16 DMs). The admin clicks Confirm on each.\n- DM message format: clear amount, recipient, wallet (redacted), intent_id, jump link to original thread.\n- On admin click: edit original DM to '\u2705 approved', send follow-up DM 'payment confirmed, sending', post reply in the intent's thread 'Payment sent to @user', delete stale flow messages in the thread via the existing safe_delete_messages primitive.\n- New AdminApprovalView persistent view class, registered on bot startup for recovery across restarts.\n- If admin DM delivery fails (discord.Forbidden, rate limit) \u2192 fail-closed, payment stays in awaiting_admin_approval, log at ERROR level. Do not auto-fall-back to public channel (assumption: DM delivery is reliable in practice; failure is rare enough to be a manual-ops event).\n\nAUTO-SKIP TEST FOR VERIFIED WALLETS:\n\n- When the admin initiates a payment via initiate_payment or initiate_batch_payment, and the recipient has a wallet_registry row with verified_at IS NOT NULL, skip the test payment creation entirely.\n- Go straight to creating the real payment row, auto-queue, trigger admin DM approval.\n- First-time and verified paths share the admin DM approval gate.\n\nHALLUCINATION FIX (softer than originally proposed):\n\n- Add the three query tools (query_payment_state, query_wallet_state, list_recent_payments) to the agent's tool palette.\n- Update the admin agent's system prompt with a new section: 'For questions about the state of payments or wallets, call query_payment_state / query_wallet_state / list_recent_payments FIRST. Do not claim state from memory or channel context.'\n- This is guidance, not enforcement. The agent CAN still hallucinate, but the operator (the admin) is the only audience, can correct, and money cannot move without an explicit tool call (which is visible and auditable).\n- Do NOT add a cog-layer rejection of replies that make state claims without query tool calls \u2014 the user specifically said not to require tool calls.\n\nWHAT THIS MEGAPLAN IS NOT TOUCHING (preserve existing invariants):\n\n- solana_client.py / solana_provider.py \u2014 the rebroadcast loop, priority fees, status.err check, RPC unreachable handling all stay.\n- Hardening pass inventory: per-user-per-day caps, canonical wallet swap defense, idempotency collision detection, WalletUpdateBlockedError, RLS comment, prompt-injection hardening in admin_chat/tools.py (wallet lookups only from wallet_registry), null-recipient fail-closed in PaymentService.confirm_payment.\n- Cleanup inventory: PaymentActor/PRODUCER_FLOWS registry, tx_signature_history column, PaymentWorkerCog + PaymentUICog split, safe_delete_messages primitive.\n- Polish inventory: reconcile_with_chain, dynamic priority fees, /payment-resolve slash command, provider name migration, docs/payments.md, docs/runbook-payments.md, scripts/check_payment_invariants.py, structured tx_confirm_decision logging.\n- Grants cog \u2014 completely unaffected. Grants uses its own thread-scoped listener, has its own flow (test auto-confirmed by bot, recipient clicks button for real payment), and this megaplan does not touch it.\n- The 'approved members can chat with bot' feature \u2014 the _can_user_message_bot path in admin_chat_cog. Under identity-based routing, approved-member messages are no longer forwarded to the agent unless the member is ALSO the ADMIN_USER_ID. This is an intentional scoping decision \u2014 the admin is the sole human who can conversationally interact with the agent. Document this in the plan explicitly so no one is surprised.\n\nSUCCESS CRITERIA:\n\n- Identity router correctly classifies admin, pending recipient, and fallthrough based solely on author identity.\n- Pending recipient state machine handles awaiting_wallet and awaiting_test_receipt_confirmation deterministically with no LLM calls.\n- Test-receipt confirmation flow: recipient's text acknowledgment is the sole gate for marking wallet_registry.verified_at (not on-chain confirmation alone).\n- Negative / ambiguous recipient responses escalate to the admin via thread tag, not silent failure.\n- 24-hour timeout on awaiting_test_receipt_confirmation \u2192 escalate to manual_review + admin DM.\n- New tools (query_*, initiate_batch_payment, upsert_wallet_for_user) are admin-only and correctly scoped.\n- initiate_batch_payment creates all intents atomically or none (DB transaction).\n- Auto-skip test path correctly bypasses the test phase for already-verified wallets.\n- Admin DM approval gate fires exactly once per real admin_chat payment, never for tests, never for grants.\n- AdminApprovalView is persistent-safe across bot restarts.\n- PaymentConfirmView button no longer fires for admin_chat real payments (grants-only now).\n- No regression in existing hardening/cleanup/polish invariants \u2014 all existing tests pass.\n- New tests cover: identity router branches, state machine state transitions, wallet regex parsing, confirmation keyword matching, batch tool atomicity, upsert_wallet_for_user admin check, auto-skip verified path, admin DM approval view persistence and click handling.",
